payload.alt: Coordinate grid: a blue arrow runs from the origin 3 units right along the x-axis, then a red arrow goes 4 units down to the point (3, negative 4).
Right triangle with legs 4 (vertical) and 10 (horizontal); angle A is at the top vertex, between the side of length 4 and the hypotenuse.
Box plot on a number line: minimum 59, first quartile 64.5, median 66, third quartile 70, maximum 77.
Kayaker in an orange kayak paddling on a flowing river with rippling current, another kayaker farther downstream near wooded banks.
Graph of g(x) = 4|x − 2| + 2, a V with vertex at (2, 2), and the horizontal line f(x) = 1 below it; the graphs never intersect.
Right triangle with legs 3 and 4 and hypotenuse 5; angle alpha is at the vertex between the side of length 3 and the hypotenuse.
Two photos: (a) pale green crystals heaped on a glass watch glass; (b) a pile of pale yellow granular powder on a white surface.
Two panels: sled moves at 1.0 m/s. Snowball thrown forward at 1.5 m/s relative to sled moves at 2.5 m/s for observer; thrown backward, at -0.5 m/s.
Table of Lewis symbols: Na + Cl gives Na+ Cl−; Mg + O gives Mg2+ O2−; Ca + 2 F gives Ca2+ with two F−, metal electrons moving to the nonmetal.
Three V-shaped absolute value graphs: (a) vertex at (-1, 2) opening up; (b) vertex at (2, 0) opening up; (c) vertex at (1, 3) opening down, x-intercepts -2 and 4.
Spectrum scale from 1 Hz to beyond 10 to the 24 Hz: radio, microwaves, infrared, a narrow visible band near 10 to the 15 Hz, ultraviolet, X rays, gamma rays.
Five d orbitals in an octahedral field: dx2-y2 and dz2 lobes point along the ligand axes; dxy, dxz and dyz lobes point between the axes.
X-ray tube: a heated filament emits electrons across a vacuum, accelerated by a high-voltage source V to a metal target that emits X rays.
Three strings of original length L0 hang from a bar, each pulled down by weight w. Stretch delta L is largest for thin nylon, smaller for thick, least for steel.
Graph of an inverted V absolute value function, vertex at (1.25, 3), crossing the x-axis at x = -0.25 and 2.75; it is below the x-axis outside them.
Graph of a blue V with vertex (3, −2) and slope ratio 1/1, compared with dashed V-shaped lines of slope ratio 2/1 in red and green.
Graphs of y = |x|, shifted right 3, stretched by 2, then shifted up 4: vertex moves from (0,0) to (3,0) to (3,4), V gets steeper.
Right triangle with the right angle at bottom left, vertical leg 10, horizontal leg 8, and angle A at the bottom right, opposite the side of length 10.
Richard Smalley, a bald man with a white goatee in a patterned jacket and tie, speaking at a podium beside a microphone.
Bar chart of 19 indicators' color-change pH ranges, from crystal violet near pH 0 to 2 to alizarin yellow R at 10 to 12; phenolphthalein turns pink at 8 to 10.
Table of sodium to argon with configurations [Ne]3s1 to [Ne]3s2 3p6; Lewis symbols show dots rising from 1 for Na to 8 for Ar.
Cube of volume V0 with face area A; equal forces F push inward on all six faces, shrinking it to a dashed inner cube of volume V0 minus delta V.
Graph of a V-shaped absolute value function f with vertex near (-0.25, -7), crossing the x-axis at (-2, 0) and (1.5, 0), where f(x) = 0.
Energy diagram: dz2 and dx2−y2 boxes (eg) sit above dxy, dxz, dyz boxes (t2g), separated by the splitting energy delta oct.
Number line centered at 5 with arrows of length 4 pointing left and right, marking all points within 4 units of 5, from 1 to 9.
Two panels: a ship moving toward Earth at v = 0.50c fires a canister at u prime = 0.75c toward Earth (left) or u prime = minus 0.75c away (right).
Unit circle with a 30-60-90 right triangle: angle pi/3 at the origin, base s, vertical side root 3 times s, hypotenuse 2s, angle pi/6 at top.
Right triangle with legs 7 and 24 and hypotenuse 25; angle t is at the right vertex, opposite the side of length 7.
Complex plane axes: a horizontal real axis crossing a vertical imaginary axis at the origin, with no points plotted.
Box plot: minimum 10, first quartile 15, median 95, third quartile 490, maximum 790; the upper half of the data is far more spread out.
Graph of x-ray intensity versus frequency: a broad hump rising then falling to zero at f max, where qV = h f max, with two sharp peaks near the top.
Right triangle formed by a tree and the ground: a point 30 feet from the tree's base, with a 57 degree angle of elevation to the treetop.
Unit circle quadrant with a right triangle: hypotenuse 1 from the origin at angle t to point (x, y) on the arc, legs x horizontal and y vertical.
Rainbow light arrows absorbed or reflected by black, white and yellow surfaces; color wheel labeled 400 to 800 nm; test tube passing violet through yellow light.
Two box plots on a 20 to 100 scale. Top: 33 to 100, box 53 to 82, median 74. Bottom: 25 to 100, narrow box 79 to 90, median 81.
Probability histogram of P(X=x) for x from 0 to 4: about 0.01, 0.19, 0.45, 0.30 and 0.04, peaking at x = 2.
Graph of force F versus elongation delta L: force rises slowly at first, then steeply and linearly, peaks, then drops and levels off.
Car moving right at speed v emits headlight light at speed c; driver label u prime equals c and sidewalk observer label u equals c, not c plus v.
View from a gondola: another gondola hangs from a sagging cable above a snowy slope, with more cars on towers ahead, so the cable carries their weight as tension.
Lewis structures: P bonded to five Cl atoms and S bonded to six F atoms by single bonds, each halogen with three lone pairs; no lone pairs on P or S.
Two cylinders of original length L0 and end area A: in (a) forces F pull outward, lengthening it by delta L; in (b) forces F push inward, shortening it by delta L.
Complex plane: from the origin, a blue arrow goes 2 units left, then a red arrow 3 units up to the point minus 2 plus 3i.
Weathered circus poster for Eastbourne, Princes Park, with a peeling corner; its printing has faded to mostly pale blue and black, with warmer colours gone.
Right triangle with angle t at the left vertex: adjacent side 56, opposite side 33, hypotenuse 65.
Right triangle with angle t at the bottom left: the hypotenuse is the slanted side, adjacent is the base, and opposite is the vertical side.
Andromeda Galaxy seen at a tilt against a dense star field: a bright core inside dusty spiral arms, with a small companion galaxy above it.
Graph of a V-shaped absolute value function with vertex at (3, -2), x-intercepts at 2 and 4, and y-intercept at 4.
Four ligands at alternate corners of a cube around a central metal; a d orbital's lobes lie between the axes, pointing nearer the ligands.
Graph of y equals absolute value of x: a V shape with vertex at the origin, rising with slope 1 to the right and slope minus 1 to the left.
Right triangle with legs 15 (bottom) and 8 (right side), hypotenuse 17; angle alpha is at the bottom left, opposite the side of 8.
Right triangle with acute angles alpha at bottom left and beta at top, right angle at bottom right; sin alpha equals cos beta and sin beta equals cos alpha.
Nail of diameter 1.50 mm sticks out 5.00 mm from a wall; the picture's weight w pulls down, the wall pushes up w, bending the end down 1.80 micrometers.
Box plot on a number line from 1 to 7: box spans 1 to 5 with no left whisker, and a right whisker extends from 5 to 7.
Two pH vs NaOH volume curves: strong acid starts near pH 1, weak acid near pH 3 with a buffer plateau; both jump sharply at 25 mL and level near 12.5.
Three capped glass vials of solution: violet-blue on the left, orange-yellow in the center, and red on the right.
Two spaceships at 0.500c, one toward Earth and one away, each fire laser light forward; the light moves at c in both cases.
X-ray of a hand: finger and palm bones appear as gray shadows inside faint soft tissue, while a ring and metal objects show as solid black.
Diagram: a line of sight from a tower top to a ground point makes an angle of depression with the horizontal at the top and an equal angle of elevation below.
Two right triangles in circles at the origin: angles pi/3 and pi/6 with sides s, root 3 s, 2s; angles pi/4 and pi/4 with legs s, s, hypotenuse root 2 s.
Bookshelf of height L0 sheared by force F pushing right at the top and F pushing left at the bottom; dashed outline shows top shifted by delta x.
Box plot on a number line from 1 to 11.5: minimum 1, first quartile 2, median 7 (dashed line), third quartile 9, maximum 11.5.
Graph: dashed red V at origin shifts to dashed green V at (3, -2); solid blue steeper V, also at (3, -2), crosses x-axis at 2 and 4.
Two photos: (a) a pile of off-white, chalky CuI powder on a clear watch glass; (b) a pile of vivid blue crystalline copper(II) nitrate powder.
Energy diagram of six d electrons: free Fe2+ has 4 unpaired; hexaaqua has t2g 4, eg 2 (4 unpaired); hexacyano has all 6 paired in t2g, eg empty.
Graph of V-shaped f with vertex at (5, 0) and horizontal line g at y = 4, meeting at x = 1 and x = 9; f is on or below g for x from 1 to 9.
Right triangle with a 30 degree angle at the top vertex; side a is adjacent to it, side 7 is opposite it, and c is the hypotenuse.
Curve of delta L versus F: straight from the origin, then curving and leveling off through the elastic region, then rising steeply to fracture.
pH vs NaOH volume: HCl starts at pH 1, acetic acid at 3; both jump at 25 mL, equivalence pH 7.00 and 8.72, levelling near pH 12.5.
Right triangle with acute angles alpha and beta: one leg is adjacent to alpha and opposite beta, the other adjacent to beta and opposite alpha.
